checkForRemovedOriginalFiles.description:
Whether to check all {@link Genai.SourceFile}s to see if the corresponding
{@link Genai.SourceFile#originalFile} still exists.
If it does not (i.e. the source file has been removed), then the source file and all downstream
artifacts ({@link Genai.SourcePassage}s, etc.) will be deleted.

doNotCheckForModifiedFiles.description:
If set true, then files within the {@link Genai.SourceCollection#rootUrl} folder which already have a corresponding
{@link Genai.SourceFile} will not be checked to see if they have been modified since the SourceFile
was created.
